## Personality

Charlie Sloane harbors a long-standing ambition to enter politics. His primary goal is to eventually serve as a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

Charlie Sloane was a student from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who had previously engaged in literary pursuits. He traveled alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by boat and train to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport), later joining them and other friends on an autumn walk around town. During his second term at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Charlie directed unwanted romantic attentions toward [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but she turned him down.

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P0](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P4](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0004), [v3 ch.Farewell P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 ch.Park P14](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0014), +7 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--charlie-sloane.md)

Charlie and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) initially shared a mutual distaste and resentment, though this hostility eventually ended. Their relationship shifted as they grew older, and Charlie became a comrade traveling alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). The two continue to socialize in the same friend group at college, participating in group outings together around [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023), [v3 ch.Farewell P0](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), +6 more_

- Enemy of — mutual distaste and resentment  _(ended v2)_  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023)</sub>
- Comrade of — traveling together to Redmond (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Farewell P0](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0000)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlie-sloane--gilbert-blythe.md)

Charlie and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are longtime friends who act as comrades, traveling together to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and participating in shared social outings. However, an underlying tension exists between them, as they are rivals for the affections of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P0](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), +7 more_
